review_title: I would look at different brands.
review_body:
You would think when you spend this much for luxury brand crock pot, it would be perfect, right? Well. As soon as I opened it and set it up, you could see the lid would not seal on the crock. It rocked. Not just a little. A LOT. So I contacted customer service at Calphalon. They asked for proof I purchased and they would send me a new crock and lid. So far, it's been 3 weeks. They said it could take 6-8 weeks and apparently so. I am very disappointed. Can't speak to how the crock works, waiting for the new crock and lid. I am sad my old faithful, 10 year old, $20 crock pot died. At least it worked right out of the box and for more than 10 years. It wasn't fancy, with timers and such. It just worked. Sigh.
I will update when I FINALLY receive the properly fitting crock and lid.

UPDATE: My apologies for not updating earlier. I had to contact the the company for a THIRD time. I was told the replacement requests had been "misplaced." Then I was told they were "backordered." I have no idea which was true. After this third person to person contact with the company I received the replacements about 3 weeks later. I have not yet tried the replacements as I have been traveling. I am hopeful they will be a better quality. Obviously quality control has been a problem here.
evidence: lid would not seal on the crock
replacement requests had been "misplaced"
rationale: 虽然初始问题是盖子不合（质量/描述不符），但评论重点在于客服处理缓慢、请求被遗漏以及长达数周的等待，主要不满集中在售后服务体验上。

review_body: Does nothing for my daughters thin curly hair. The bottle arrived with no top on it, the smell is terrible it makes my daughter cough when I spray it on her hair and it leaves hair feeling greasy. Needless to say I would not buy this product again.
evidence: The bottle arrived with no top on it
it makes my daughter cough when I spray it on her hair
rationale: 首要问题是瓶盖缺失（交付/包装问题），导致产品无法正常使用并引发健康不适（咳嗽）。虽然涉及健康和性能，但根本触发点是交付时的物理缺失。

review_body: It was not at all what I thought was advertised! I was expecting a tinted lotion! As a plain lotion, it’s still doesn’t get any stars! It’s very thin and runny! Sorry Joan!
evidence: I was expecting a tinted lotion!
As a plain lotion, it’s still doesn’t get any stars! It’s very thin and runny!
rationale: 用户期望的是染色乳液，但收到的是普通乳液，且质地稀薄，这符合对描述/期望的落差。

review_body: My cat ate the first treat and hasn’t eaten one since.
evidence: My cat ate the first treat and hasn’t eaten one since.
rationale: 同样是宠物对食物的接受度问题，非产品质量缺陷。

review_body: Put the pads under the feet of the washer and leveled it. Simply didn't work. The washer still shakes a lot and moves quite a bit during a cycle.
evidence: Simply didn't work.
The washer still shakes a lot and moves quite a bit during a cycle.
rationale: 尽管尝试了调平垫，洗衣机在运行期间仍然剧烈震动和移动，表明其稳定功能失效。

review_title: Filter arrived with "stuff" embedded in it....
review_body: Arrived with bits of lint or hair, some black specks. Even though it arrived SEALED, either where they are made has stuff flying around or they are left out before being sealed. The WHOLE point of a filter is to...filter...make the air cleaner and if a filter arrives with who-knows-what embedded in it, hardly usable. I have tried different filters for my Hamilton Beach air cleaner and the best I found was the one FROM Hamilton Beach. I will go back and see if I can find THAT one again on Amazon. This one is going in the garbage.
evidence: Arrived with bits of lint or hair, some black specks.
if a filter arrives with who-knows-what embedded in it, hardly usable.
rationale: 滤网虽密封但内部含有灰尘毛发等杂质，导致无法正常发挥过滤作用，属于制造质量缺陷。

review_body: what the heck is it? this corn is blue corn, hope you like blue stains all over everything including your mouth. That's if you do not mind trying to bite into after cooking it to make it soft enough to eat. Good Luck with that. Bought it as blue corn is supposed to help with cholesterol. With this you may get better cholesterol and lose your teeth.
evidence: hope you like blue stains all over everything including your mouth
With this you may get better cholesterol and lose your teeth
rationale: 评论提到产品导致牙齿脱落风险及染色问题，涉及严重的健康和安全隐患。

review_body: I'm afraid to put eggs in this thing it's made of hard plastic and the holes it has are to small for my large eggs .
evidence: holes it has are to small for my large eggs
rationale: 评论指出产品孔洞尺寸过小，导致无法容纳大鸡蛋，属于尺寸/适配性问题。

review_body: I used it once..... sorry I bought it.
evidence: used it once..... sorry I bought it.
rationale: 仅表达使用后后悔，未提及具体缺陷或原因，证据不足，按规则归类为不明确。

review_title: Boiling water sound on app is accurate reflection of anger level when trying to connect.
review_body:
"irelessly connects to your mobile device to track the number of eggs you have and tell you when they're going bad" is the first bullet of the description. NOT SO MUCH. Much ire.

NOT SO MUCH. Super cool idea. Watching two programmers laughing trying to set it up. Returning.
evidence: Walking two programmers laughing trying to set it up
NOT SO MUCH
rationale: 评论指出产品难以连接和设置，导致用户感到愤怒并退货。

review_body: Very, very, disappointed in this product, there is only a couple of chunks of actual food and about 2 tablespoons of broth isn't enough for and cat or kitten, all 24 pouches probably would fill one can of regular cat food, would not at all suggest way over priced but of course your paying for the name not the actual food.
evidence: way over priced
only a couple of chunks of actual food
rationale: 评论认为产品价格过高且内容物（肉块）极少，性价比极低，同时也暗示实物与预期不符。

review_body: Only 2 colors in the variety box and both are shades of red.
evidence: Not the 4 colors advertised
Only 2 colors in the variety box
rationale: 收到的商品颜色数量与广告描述不符，属于发错货或描述不符导致的实际物品差异。
